services.name: Aquatic Therapy (Hydrotherapy)
services.desc: At ATI Physical Therapy, our aquatic physical therapy experts dive deep into the healing power of water. Whether you’re riding the waves of recovery, navigating the currents of chronic pain, or seeking to enhance your mobility flow, our skilled aquatic therapy specialists are your lifeguards on this therapeutic journey. Aquatic therapy, or hydrotherapy, is a specialized form of rehabilitation that utilizes water’s therapeutic properties to promote healing and recovery. This gentle yet effective approach harnesses water’s natural buoyancy, resistance, and warmth to relieve pain, enhance mobility, and strengthen muscles.
